title: Position: Societal Impacts Research Requires Benchmarks for Creative Composition Tasks
models_tested: This paper does not formally evaluate specific LLMs. Instead, it performs a thematic analysis on user prompts from datasets (WildChat-1M, LMSYS-Chat-1M) that were collected from user interactions with models such as GPT-3.5-Turbo, GPT-4, and Vicuna.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic is outside the scope of its analysis.
